node.statement: Case S_P={0}: for every m>=1, M_m tensor S_P={0}. Thus every Z in M_m tensor S_P is zero; linearity of the amplified Ha-map gives T_m(Z)=T_m(0)=0, while (1-C_diag*e)||Z||=0. Hence the root estimate holds at every level and this case is complete without introducing a_m or an infimum over an empty set.
